diagnosis: All four rollouts passed content check C2, which depends on PF1, despite PF1 being owned by A2 and thus unavailable to the lone decision-makers. This suggests that the model is defaulting to enabling both idempotency-key enforcement and a deduplication gate before production, even without the explicit information provided by PF1.

C2.why: The staging run appears ready without this finding; PF1 changes the safeguard from the draft's unspecified behavior to enabling both idempotency-key enforcement and a deduplication gate before production.
